unit.title: Describing Words, More Verbs, and a Longer Story

lesson.title: Two New Verbs: Reading and Writing
lesson.subject: punjabi

contentBlocks.text: ਇਸ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਨਵੇਂ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਸਿੱਖੇ। ਅੱਜ ਦੋ ਨਵੀਆਂ ਕਿਰਿਆਵਾਂ: ਪੜ੍ਹਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਲਿਖਣਾ! (This week you've learned new words. Today, two new verbs: to read and to write!)

ਪੜ੍ਹਨਾ means 'to read' and ਲਿਖਣਾ means 'to write' — just like last week's verbs, they change with gender: ਪੜ੍ਹਦਾ/ਪੜ੍ਹਦੀ (reads) and ਲਿਖਦਾ/ਲਿਖਦੀ (writes). A new noun connects both: ਕਿਤਾਬ (book). Practice: 'ਮੈਂ ਕਿਤਾਬ ਪੜ੍ਹਦਾ ਹਾਂ' (I read a book, for a boy) or 'ਮੈਂ ਕਿਤਾਬ ਪੜ੍ਹਦੀ ਹਾਂ' (I read a book, for a girl). Say the sentence for yourself, using the correct form.
ਤੁਸੀਂ ਪੜ੍ਹਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਲਿਖਣਾ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ! (You just learned to read and write!) Tomorrow we'll read a real, longer story using everything from this week.

objectives: Learn two new verbs, ਪੜ੍ਹਨਾ (to read) and ਲਿਖਣਾ (to write), with correct gendered forms
Learn the noun ਕਿਤਾਬ (book) and use it in a self-referential sentence
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review this week's describing words and sentence-building.
2. Introduce ਪੜ੍ਹਨਾ, ਲਿਖਣਾ, and ਕਿਤਾਬ.
3. Have the child say the correct-gender 'I read a book' sentence about themselves.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's story, which uses this week's full vocabulary.
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just ਪੜ੍ਹਨਾ (reading) first, since it directly ties to tomorrow's story lesson
Ready for more: ask the child to also say 'ਮੈਂ ਕਿਤਾਬ ਲਿਖਦਾ/ਲਿਖਦੀ ਹਾਂ' (I write a book)
Directly connects to the course's own 'reading short stories' description — worth naming that connection explicitly for the child
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a vocabulary and self-application activity — check that the child correctly uses ਪੜ੍ਹਦਾ ਹਾਂ or ਪੜ੍ਹਦੀ ਹਾਂ matching their own gender when saying 'I read a book.'
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's 'common verbs' and 'reading short stories' goals together, introducing the exact verb (reading) tomorrow's story lesson will use.
